name: Scheme-I (ISI Mark - Product Certification Scheme)
description: Standard product certification scheme under BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations 2018, Schedule-II. Involves assessment of the manufacturing infrastructure, production process, quality control, in-house testing facilities, and testing of product samples in independent BIS/recognized labs.
governing_act: Bureau of Indian Standards Act 2016, Section 13 & Schedule-II Scheme-I
surveillance_frequency: Periodic factory surveillance and market sample drawing (6-12 months)
documentation_requirements: Manufacturing plant layout, machinery list, in-house test equipment calibration certificates, test personnel qualification, Scheme of Inspection & Testing (SIT) acceptance, Process flow diagram, Raw material test certificates.

name: Scheme-II (CRS - Compulsory Registration Scheme)
description: Registration scheme primarily applicable to electronics, IT, and solar photovoltaic products under notifications from MeitY, MNRE, and Ministry of Power. Manufacturers self-declare conformity based on test reports from BIS-recognized laboratories without mandatory preliminary factory audit.
governing_act: Bureau of Indian Standards (Conformity Assessment) Regulations 2018, Schedule-II Scheme-II
mark_name: Standard Mark for CRS (with Registration No. R-XXXXXXXX)
surveillance_frequency: Market surveillance with random sample picking from commercial distribution channels
documentation_requirements: Valid Test Report from BIS-recognized laboratory (under 90 days old), Undertaking of Conformity, Brand Authorisation Letter, Local Representative Affidavit (for foreign manufacturers), Trademark registration certificate.

name: Scheme-IV (Certificate of Conformity)
description: Certificate of Conformity issued for batches or specific lots of goods where continuous factory inspection is not viable or for specialized imported consignments.
documentation_requirements: Batch manufacturing records, dispatch consignment notes, third-party lab test reports, port entry documents.

name: Scheme-X (Simplified Conformity for Industrial Capital Goods)
description: Conformity assessment scheme tailored for large custom machinery, industrial plants, transformers, and heavy capital goods requiring technical construction files and prototype evaluation.
surveillance_frequency: Annual verification and design modification review
documentation_requirements: Complete engineering design calculations, finite element analysis, material test certificates, weld inspection records, witnessed factory acceptance tests.
